# DC Solutions

> DC Solutions (DC SOLUTIONS LTDA, Brazil) is a digital products company. It builds and looks after each product, from code to customer support. This website (dcsolutions.app) presents the company and its products; it sells nothing. Each product has its own website, terms of use and privacy policy.

Run by Daniel Cortez. Contact: contato@dcsolutions.app. Language of this website: English.

## Products

- [IQNorth](https://iqnorth.com/en/): Live. Online IQ test with a confidence range: 40 reasoning questions in 6 areas, in about 20 minutes, with the estimated IQ shown with its 95% range and the result by area. In Portuguese, English and Spanish.
- [Fytform](https://fytform.com/): Live. Workouts and diet built around you: 17 questions in about 5 minutes give the week's workouts and a diet in grams, with swaps, on your phone. In Portuguese.
- [PartiuGringa](https://partiugringa.com/): Live. Helps Brazilian developers land international jobs: an AI review of your LinkedIn profile, remote roles open to LATAM, and a tailored CV for each job. In Portuguese.
- [Runemoire](https://runemoire.com/): In development. A roguelike deckbuilder in pixel art for PC, in Portuguese, English, Spanish, French and German.
- [Ismeire Cortez](https://ismeirecortez.com/): Live. Website of nutritionist Ismeire Cortez (CRN9 22936), specialized in obesity and weight loss, with booking via WhatsApp. In Portuguese.

## Company website

- [Home](https://dcsolutions.app/): The company and its products, how we work, FAQ and contact.
- [Privacy](https://dcsolutions.app/privacy): How this website handles personal data: no cookies, no tracking, only what you send us by email.
- [Terms of use](https://dcsolutions.app/terms): Terms of use of this website; each product has its own terms.
